summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Python Script Manager MVP. 16/16 pytest backend tests pass (auth, files CRUD, projects lifecycle, start/stop, pip install, env persistence, schedule persistence). All 13 requested UI flows pass end-to-end via Playwright: correct/wrong login, sidebar nav, file listing/mkdir/upload/edit-persist, register folder as project, start/stop with logs, env editor persistence, daily auto-restart persistence, delete project, logout + protected-route guard, and 401 without token.

minor.issue: Uploads to root workspace path are OK but if `dest` is empty the safe_resolve treats root as workspace; verified working. Just note: no MIME/size validation.
Does not remove the project's .venv or workspace files (may be intentional, but worth documenting).

issues: The file-row div itself is not clickable; only the inner 'open-{name}' button navigates. Not a bug, but tests must click open-{name}, not file-row-{name}.

critical_code_review_comments: auth.py get_current_user also reads cookies but login never sets httpOnly cookies — cookie branch is dead code (frontend uses Bearer token via localStorage 'psm_token').
No brute-force lockout / rate limiting on /api/auth/login (playbook_testing_instructions expected lockout after 5 fails).
CORS is wide-open (CORS_ORIGINS=* combined with allow_credentials=True). Browsers ignore credentials with '*', but this is still lax; recommend explicit origins in production.

process_manager keeps subprocess handles in a module-level dict, so after backend restart the dict is empty but PIDs may still be alive; is_running falls back to psutil.pid_exists which is fine but PID recycling isn't guarded (no start-time check).
pip_install and start_project run synchronously on the FastAPI worker (blocking) — venv creation can take several seconds and blocks the event loop. Recommend offloading to a thread executor.
Path traversal correctly rejected on /api/files/list. Good.
Project model has python_version='3.12' default but manager uses PYTHON_BIN env override; the model field is unused.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up TEST_dir_* and TEST_proj_* via API tests. UI test created uifolder_86578, uiscript.py, uifolder_86578/main.py in /app/workspace (leftover, not cleaned up) — safe to remove.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Auth: POST /api/auth/login returns access_token (Bearer). Long-running test scripts should be `import time; time.sleep(300)` so status stays 'running'. First start of a project triggers .venv creation (may take 10-20s) — use larger timeouts. FileManager row clicks must target [data-testid='open-{name}'], not file-row-{name}.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in the requested flows.
